items.objective: Focus on temporal reuse across the six dependent steps. Compare a spatial-only tiled control with a halo-aware multi-step tile, holding the spatial kernel and threading strategy fixed within the comparison to isolate temporal reuse. Respect radius-three dependencies, produce both full output buffers with baseline initialization and boundaries, and include scratch allocation in timing. Avoid benchmark-size specialization; validate correctness and measure one- and four-core wall time.
